$comment: Side quests: an agent in its own worktree, a task of its own, out of the pair's way.
do: caption:A side quest comes up|The pair is busy. Don't hand it to them.
caption:Start an agent in its own worktree|A second folder of the repo, on its own branch.
caption:Give it a task of its own|From the board, the same as any task.
fill:Add a task…=Fix the flaky checkout test @fixer !

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
caption:It works in its own thread|The pair's thread doesn't hear a word of it.
caption:Done and resolved|Its own small pull request, nothing to clean up.
